volume_properties.name: Unique data-block ID name (within a same type and library)
volume_properties.name_full: Unique data-block ID name, including library one if any
volume_properties.session_uid: A session-wide unique identifier for the data block that remains the same across renames and internal reallocations, unchanged when reloading the file
volume_properties.is_evaluated: Whether this ID is runtime-only, evaluated data-block, or actual data from .blend file
volume_properties.original: Actual data-block from .blend file (Main database) that generated that evaluated one
volume_properties.users: Number of times this data-block is referenced
volume_properties.use_fake_user: Save this data-block even if it has no users
volume_properties.use_extra_user: Indicates whether an extra user is set or not (mainly for internal/debug usages)
volume_properties.is_embedded_data: This data-block is not an independent one, but is actually a sub-data of another ID (typical example: root node trees or master collections)
volume_properties.is_linked_packed: This data-block is linked and packed into the .blend file
volume_properties.is_missing: This data-block is a place-holder for missing linked data (i.e. it is [an override of] a linked data that could not be found anymore)
volume_properties.is_runtime_data: This data-block is runtime data, i.e. it won't be saved in .blend file. Note that e.g. evaluated IDs are always runtime, so this value is only editable for data-blocks in Main data-base.
volume_properties.is_editable: This data-block is editable in the user interface. Linked data-blocks are not editable, except if they were loaded as editable assets.
volume_properties.tag: Tools can use this to tag data for their own purposes (initial state is undefined)
volume_properties.is_library_indirect: Is this ID block linked indirectly
volume_properties.library: Library file the data-block is linked from
volume_properties.library_weak_reference: Weak reference to a data-block in another library .blend file (used to re-use already appended data instead of appending new copies)
volume_properties.asset_data: Additional data for an asset data-block
volume_properties.preview: Preview image and icon of this data-block (always None if not supported for this type of data)
volume_properties.filepath: Volume file used by this Volume data-block
volume_properties.is_sequence: Whether the cache is separated in a series of files
volume_properties.frame_start: Global starting frame of the sequence, assuming first has a #1
volume_properties.frame_duration: Number of frames of the sequence to use
volume_properties.frame_offset: Offset the number of the frame to use in the animation
volume_properties.velocity_grid: Name of the velocity field, or the base name if the velocity is split into multiple grids
volume_properties.velocity_unit: Define how the velocity vectors are interpreted with regard to time, 'frame' means the delta time is 1 frame, 'second' means the delta time is 1 / FPS
volume_properties.velocity_scale: Factor to control the amount of motion blur
volume_properties.velocity_x_grid: Name of the grid for the X axis component of the velocity field if it was split into multiple grids
volume_properties.velocity_y_grid: Name of the grid for the Y axis component of the velocity field if it was split into multiple grids
volume_properties.velocity_z_grid: Name of the grid for the Z axis component of the velocity field if it was split into multiple grids

domain_cache_properties.gravity: Gravity in X, Y and Z direction
domain_cache_properties.dissolve_speed: Determine how quickly the smoke dissolves (lower value makes smoke disappear faster)
domain_cache_properties.use_dissolve_smoke_log: Dissolve smoke in a logarithmic fashion. Dissolves quickly at first, but lingers longer.
domain_cache_properties.cache_frame_start: Frame on which the simulation starts (first frame baked)
domain_cache_properties.cache_frame_end: Frame on which the simulation stops (last frame baked)
domain_cache_properties.cache_frame_offset: Frame offset that is used when loading the simulation from the cache. It is not considered when baking the simulation, only when loading it.
domain_cache_properties.cache_mesh_format: Select the file format to be used for caching surface data
domain_cache_properties.cache_data_format: Select the file format to be used for caching volumetric data
domain_cache_properties.cache_particle_format: Select the file format to be used for caching particle data
domain_cache_properties.cache_noise_format: Select the file format to be used for caching noise data
domain_cache_properties.cache_type: Change the cache type of the simulation
domain_cache_properties.cache_resumable: Additional data will be saved so that the bake jobs can be resumed after pausing. Because more data will be written to disk it is recommended to avoid enabling this option when baking at high resolutions.
domain_cache_properties.cache_directory: Directory that contains fluid cache files

flow_properties.use_initial_velocity: Fluid has some initial velocity when it is emitted
flow_properties.velocity_factor: Multiplier of source velocity passed to fluid (source velocity is non-zero only if object is moving)
flow_properties.velocity_coord: Additional initial velocity in X, Y and Z direction (added to source velocity)
flow_properties.volume_density: Controls fluid emission from within the mesh (higher value results in greater emissions from inside the mesh)
flow_properties.density_vertex_group: Name of vertex group which determines surface emission rate

source: Installed native RNA introspection; no production scene read or mutated.
